ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface across ~85-90% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels concentrated along the peripheral margins and at the basal insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a single contiguous low-intensity dark blob. High-intensity geometric clusters are mapped exclusively to the outer lateral edges and the trailing edge tips. Distinctive small-scale high-intensity circular motifs are localized on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth are continuous along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased complexity near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer lateral margins, tapering to sharp, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive high-intensity circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are densely packed along the entire left and right lateral margins. Several distinct, isolated circular ring-marks (scars) are visible on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical high-intensity linear disruptions are detectable on the lower central and lower right quadrants of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy peripheral colonization by barnacles; multiple circular depigmentation scars on the right lobe; prominent jaggedness of the trailing edge suggesting minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright specular highlights at the fluke base caused by water surface interface reflection.
